Relaxed on 27 Oct 2026. Most small-ship departures fall here, but the Coastal Pacific does not run 1 May–31 Aug. Cold, short days, possible Milford Road avalanche closures. Settled spells, no sandflies, few tourists, discounts.

About 3.5 hours. The 08:45 from Wellington connects with the 13:40 Coastal Pacific. Bags check through to Christchurch. Northbound, the 14:15 from Picton connects with the Coastal Pacific arriving 12:40. Times may change with the new ferries.
Spring pattern in recent seasons: Thursday to Sunday. Southbound departs Picton 13:40, arrives Christchurch 19:30. Northbound departs Christchurch 07:00.

Great Journeys says the season runs from 1 September. seat61 says late September, and the 2024 season actually started 19 Sep. This decides whether a mid-September trip south can use the train.
